articles.summary: KB Home (NYSE: KBH), one of the largest and most trusted homebuilders in the U.S., today announced the opening of Morningside, a new-home community in Dade City, Florida. Morningside at a Glance: Price: From the high $200,000s Location: Dade City, Florida, at the corner of US-98 and Morning Ridge Trail Home type: One- and two-story, single-family floor plans Bedrooms/baths: Up to 5 bedrooms and 3 baths School district: Pasco County Schools Morningside is located at the corner of US-98 and Morning Ridge Trail. The community provides easy access to US-301 and is just minutes away from AdventHealth medical center and shopping and dining along US-98. Residents will enjoy Morningside's proximity to hiking at Hillsborough River State Park and wildlife viewing at Giraffe Ranch. The homes at Morningside are designed for contemporary living, with modern kitchens overlooking large great rooms, expansive bedroom suites with walk-in closets, and lofts. articles.summary: KB Home (NYSE: KBH), one of the largest and most trusted homebuilders in the U.S., today announced the opening of the first phase of Sandstone, the homebuilder's massive new master plan in North Las Vegas. This master plan spans nearly 300 acres, with four new communities and over 1,500 new homes within the Villages at Tule Springs. Sandstone also offers over 12 acres of planned on-site parks, an extensive trail system and a new trailhead with access to the Tule Springs Fossil Beds National Monument. "KB Home's new Sandstone master plan represents a significant investment in North Las Vegas and our future," said Scott Black, Mayor Pro Tem, City of North Las Vegas. "These new homes will help provide more attainable homeownership opportunities for years to come, while creating jobs, supporting local businesses and generating economic activity throughout our city."
